retrieved_chunks.text:
Northport Workshop hours

The weekday opening time is 09:00. The weekday closing time is 17:00.

retrieved_chunks.title: Password Policy
retrieved_chunks.text:
Northport Workshop password policy

Staff passwords are issued by the clerk and are never written in this file. Password questions about the red cabinet are not answered here. See the lockout plate.

retrieved_chunks.title: Shift
retrieved_chunks.text: The morning shift starts when the Northport Workshop opens. Password binders stay with the clerk.

retrieved_chunks.title: Password Notice

Notice

retrieved_chunks.title: Safety
retrieved_chunks.text:
Safety briefing

Lock the red cabinet at the end of the shift. Workshop passwords are personal. This briefing does not list a code.

retrieved_chunks.title: Tools
retrieved_chunks.text: The torque wrench lives in drawer 2. This page does not mention a password.

retrieved_chunks.title: Password Faq
retrieved_chunks.text:
Password FAQ

The clerk issues passwords. The red cabinet password is not stored in this FAQ. A workshop password reset takes one business day.

retrieved_chunks.title: Training
retrieved_chunks.text: New-staff training covers the password policy and the red cabinet. No code is printed on the training sheet.

retrieved_chunks.title: Inventory
retrieved_chunks.text: The red cabinet holds gloves and ear plugs. This inventory does not list a password or a lockout code.
